title: Choosing his burial place with his wife and mother
summary: They visited the graves on All Saints Day; he would be buried in the same grave as his late wife Jeannette and his mother, and she visits daily.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did he know, did he choose the place where he was going to be buried?

Yes. He had, when we went on All Saints, All Souls Day, I took him to the graveside and put flowers on Jeannette's grave, his wife's grave, late wife's grave, and on his mother's grave. They were both buried in the same place. And he said, this is where I'm going to be. Not here. He didn't say to me many times, I want to stop there and say some prayers. And he always said, it won't be long now before you'll be coming here. He said, because I'm going to be out here very shortly and you'll be coming to see me. Was he buried in fact, right in there with his wife and mother? In the same, in the same grave. Oh, in the same grave. Yes. You can wait a year. And I do know, I remember asking, I said, well, not having any definite place where I had buried, would I, could I possibly be buried there? And he said, yes. So my burial place is already to be in the same. Have you been out there since? Every day. I believe I missed maybe three or four days since his death. I go over there and say prayer. I told him I would never, as long as my husband, I would never stop visiting him.
